column1: # tests/memfn/simd_bounds.tsv -- [MEMFN] RQ-3 (D155 item 9 + addendum 2): each SIMD row's
# declared bound on the CPU-guarded bytes ONE rendering writes (Q-R9-9's
# per-row bound, `mf_formdecl.guarded_max` once the kit declares it).
# simd_guarded_check.py holds every artifact's <PREFIX>_SIMD_GUARDED_BYTES
# to the sum of these over its rendered sites; a MEMFN_FORMS token with no
# row here FAILS (UNDECLARED). No aggregate budget exists (addendum 2).
# form<TAB>guarded_max
# A MEMFN_FORMS token `FORM@L1+L2...` (a SIMD row's rendered levels, top
# down) is bounded by the SUM of its rows' bounds, row `FORM-Lk` per level
# (R4e' batch 1, R-13); a token with no `@` by its own row.
# rq3-witness: the test-only synthetic block (-DPCREC_SIMD_WITNESS, 60,000
# pad lines of 27 bytes plus ~190 of guard, comment, table and #endif:
# 1,620,166 bytes measured). Under 2x the block, so a bracket that counts a
# block twice exceeds it (S703).
rq3-witness
# vrun-w16 / vrun-w32 (R4e' batch 1, R-13): one FUNC's helper block at that
# level and, for the top level, the selector's one call line (U2: the
# selector carries no CPU #if, so no arm and no #else/#endif; the bounds
# below were measured with them and not re-measured since, so they are
# looser by those lines). MEASURED by G2's
# SIMD family (memfn/tests/run_g2_simd.py) at pcrec's placeholder prefix and
# longest FUNC name, each row rendered ALONE: worst 2,661 (w16) and 2,721
# (w32) bytes, a 32-byte masked run compared byte by byte under
# -fno-run-overlap and filtered on two masked positions (lane rankuse's KB;
# R-13's KA-only filter measured 2,383 / 2,413); both rendered 5,370 <=
# 2,700 + 2,800. Those are the whole-run verify's (`--memfn=no-vrun-trim`);
# R-14's trimmed verify writes 2,583 / 2,643 / 5,214 there (lane r14b), so
# the bound, the larger arm, did not move. The padded main-path verify
# (lane r14p, `--memfn=no-vrun-pad` its deny) applies to runs of 3 or 5-7
# bytes only, so the 32-byte worst case is unchanged (G2 measures the alone
# arm as the largest over trim x pad). R-16 (lane r16b, D147 addendum 16):
# the w16 helper reads no second filter position at any arm, so w16's alone
# worst is 2,383 again (w32 2,721 unchanged; both rendered 4,975 over G2's
# space <= 2,400 + 2,800). Rounded up to the next 100. The kit states the same
# (memfn/src/vrun.c VRUN_W*_GUARDED_MAX).
vrun-w32
vrun-w16
# target-text ([XARCH-DEV] U3): the kit's family guard and one target's
# region (open + close), written once per artifact for a SIMD target whatever
# its forms. MEASURED (lane u3tgt, 2026-11-08) over the kit's targets: the
# largest, the 32-byte target (20 feature tokens), writes 615 bytes (a
# compound `split` artifact whose forms are "none" stamps exactly that); the
# baseline amd64 target 469, the arm64 one 165 (its guard alone); rounded up
# to 700. simd_guarded_check reaches every target's text (a `simd:` arm per
# listed target). The header lines placed ahead of the region join it (lane
# u3crit, review r5 X-1/X-2): a rendered level's vector header (23 bytes
# each, 46 with both amd64 levels; moved out of the kit's level text, so a
# vrun row's bytes shrink by as much) and a compound part's `#include
# <string.h>` (20): at most 615 + 46 + 20 = 681, inside this bound.
target-text
